ruleset.name: ISW2 code smells
ruleset.description:
The rules whose violations are the code smells of the dataset, i.e. the five defect-oriented categories PMD catalogues its Java rules under. The two left out, "codestyle" and "documentation", are about how the source is written down rather than about what it does, and their violations would bury the smells of a class under its formatting and its Javadoc.
The ruleset is carried by the project rather than taken from the PMD distribution, because the smell counts of the oldest release and of the newest one are only comparable if the rules that produced them are the same. For the very same reason the image running it is pinned to a version: see project.metrics.pmd.image.
Rules are referenced by category, and their priority is left as PMD assigns it: the severity a smell is counted under is the one PMD describes it with, as the catalogue in the README says.
